checks: A real credit after a partial payment reduces the payable without changing cash records
Cash 250 plus credit 2250 closes invoice 2500 while amountPaid remains actual cash
Credit reversal reopens the retained invoice and restores payable 2250 without changing payment effects
Credit and payment retries do not overwrite the subsequently reopened invoice
Credit beyond the unpaid portion preserves the supplier credit position instead of inventing extra cash paid
scope: Owned localhost receiving, invoice approval, payment request/approval/execution and supplier credit/reversal services. Return/credit service actor arguments are trusted fixture scope, not proof of their public-action authority. Accounting rules and external bank evidence synthetic; no external payment or notification delivery.
